tools.name: create_thread
tools.title: Create a Thread
tools.description: Use when someone describes a commitment that involves several people or steps and has a deadline, e.g. "Thread Leo's tournament Saturday; Sam has the jersey, I'm driving." Creates a Thread. THREAD derives the conditions that must become true, so don't invent them. Person ids come from list_threads members. Returns the Thread with owners, conditions and status.

tools.name: list_threads
tools.title: List Threads
tools.description: Use when the user asks what's on, what's coming up, or what's at risk, e.g. "What's on this weekend?" Returns the user's Threads (title, status, time) and the household members (ids and names) for resolving names like "Sam".

tools.name: get_thread
tools.title: Get a Thread
tools.description: Use when the user asks about one commitment or asks why, e.g. "How's Leo's tournament looking?" or "Why Sam?" Returns status, owners, conditions with evidence strength, risks, and plain-language reasons (why).

tools.name: report_change
tools.title: Report a change
tools.description: Use when the user says something changed that may break plans: they are unavailable ("I can't drive Saturday morning") or an event moved. People can only report their own availability. Returns every affected Thread with severity, including ones that are NOT affected, the reasons, and ranked people or services who could take over. It never reassigns anything by itself.

tools.name: request_handoff
tools.title: Hand off a responsibility
tools.description: Use when the user wants someone else to take a responsibility, e.g. "Ask Sam to take it" or "Can someone else get Rosa's refill?" Omit candidate to let THREAD choose the best eligible person or service. A person receives a request they must accept. A service returns requires_confirmation and nothing is ordered until confirm_action. Returns the handoff and a Context Receipt (what was shared and what was withheld).

tools.name: respond_to_handoff
tools.title: Answer a handoff
tools.description: Use only when the person who received a handoff answers it, e.g. "Yes, I've got it" or "I can't." confirm_items records items they confirm (e.g. ["jersey"]). add_to_calendar (default true) lets THREAD put the commitment on their own calendar. Accepting never resolves the Thread. Returns the updated Thread.

tools.name: record_evidence
tools.title: Record progress
tools.description: Use when the responsible person reports progress or completion, e.g. "Jersey's in the car" or "We're here." THREAD checks who said it and when, and returns which conditions are still open. Nobody can mark a Thread resolved: resolution follows from evidence.

tools.name: confirm_action
tools.title: Approve or reject
tools.description: Use when the named person approves or rejects a pending confirmation, e.g. "Yes, order it" or "Yes, add it to my calendar." Purchases always need this. Returns the confirmation and the updated Thread.
